_comment: Hand-measured corrections applied on top of the automatic cell detection.
The detector resolves 81 of 83 rows from the card's structure. These two it
cannot, and the reason is specific: the last section of the back-left block
ends with 'Other (write-in):', a caption set smaller and lighter than the
rest, sitting between the 'Mini Toiletry Bottles' caption above it and the
table's closing border below. No combination of ink threshold and merge
distance separates all three -- every setting that splits the caption from
the border also shatters a wrapped caption elsewhere in the section.
Rather than keep bending the detector around one row, the two bands are
measured directly and pinned here. Values are y-coordinates in the
Measured ink positions: 'Mini Toiletry Bottles' caption spans y 1934-1978;
'Other (write-in):' spans y 2002-2026; the closing border sits at y 2086.
The row boundary is the midpoint of the whitespace between the captions.
Re-measure these if the card is ever redesigned. detect-cells.mjs prints a
warning for every override it applies, so they cannot rot silently.
